tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand colour as ink and lines, Tailwind blue (blue-600; blue-300 in dark): text buttons, selected states, links, focus outline, focused field lines. As text on background/surface: 5.3:1 light, 10.3:1 dark (6.5:1 on surface-dp24). For filled controls use primary-fill. on-primary pairs with it: white on blue-600 (5.3:1), black on blue-300 (11.6:1).

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of high-emphasis controls (contained buttons): saturated blue-600 in both themes. Text and icons on it use on-primary-fill, white, 5.3:1.

tokens.name: on-primary-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary-fill fill (white, 5.3:1 on blue-600).

tokens.name: primary-variant
tokens.usage: Darker primary (blue-800) for the status bar and app bar contrast against primary. White text on it is 8.8:1. Not a text colour in dark (2.1:1 on #121212).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Accent, chartreuse (Lime A400 from the original Material Design palette): switches, checkboxes, selection controls, highlighted text fields' cursors. Black text and icons on it are 17.7:1. Never as text on background or surface in light (1.2:1 on white); 15.8:1 on #121212.

tokens.name: secondary-variant
tokens.usage: Darker secondary (Lime A700 in light) for contrast against secondary fills (checked switch track in light).

tokens.name: fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button fill, Tailwind red-600 in both themes. The icon uses on-fab, white (4.8:1). Only for the FAB; never as text or for errors, which use error.

tokens.name: on-fab
tokens.usage: Icon and label on a fab fill.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page behind all surfaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets at 0dp: cards, menus and dialogs before elevation overlay. In dark, raise with the surface-dpNN tokens.

tokens.name: surface-dp01
tokens.usage: Surface at 1dp elevation (cards, resting). Dark: 5% white overlay on #121212.

tokens.name: surface-dp02
tokens.usage: Surface at 2dp (contained buttons, resting). Dark: 7% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp04
tokens.usage: Surface at 4dp (top app bar). Dark: 9% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp06
tokens.usage: Surface at 6dp (FAB resting, snackbar). Dark: 11% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp08
tokens.usage: Surface at 8dp (bottom navigation, menus, raised cards). Dark: 12% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp12
tokens.usage: Surface at 12dp (FAB pressed). Dark: 14% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp16
tokens.usage: Surface at 16dp (navigation drawer, modal sheets). Dark: 15% overlay.

tokens.name: surface-dp24
tokens.usage: Surface at 24dp (dialogs). Dark: 16% overlay.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors: text field error state, helper text, error icons. As text on surface: 7.3:1 light, 5.2:1 dark; a floating label in error on a dark filled-field is 4.2:1, under 4.5:1, kept as specified. Always pair with an icon or message, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a secondary fill (checkbox check, switch).

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Base ink on background. Use the text-* emphasis tokens for type.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Base ink on surface; also the colour of state overlays on surface.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an error fill.

tokens.name: text-high
tokens.usage: High-emphasis text (87%): headlines, body copy, on background and every surface-dpNN. 16.1:1 light; dark 14.2:1 on surface, 9.3:1 on surface-dp24.

tokens.name: text-medium
tokens.usage: Medium-emphasis text (60%): secondary lines, helper text, inactive tabs and navigation labels. 5.7:1 light; dark 7.2:1 on surface, 5.9:1 on surface-dp08.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons (38%). Exempt from contrast minimums; never use for active content.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Dividers, outlined button and outlined card borders (12%). Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined text field border at rest (38%). The Classic Material Design value is 2.7:1 on white, under the 3:1 control-border floor; hover raises it to text-high and focus to primary.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled contained button (12%).

tokens.name: filled-field
tokens.usage: Container of a filled text field (on-surface at 4% light; 9% dark per the MDC dark theme).

tokens.name: snackbar-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar container: on-surface mixed 80% into surface.

tokens.name: on-snackbar
tokens.usage: Snackbar message text on snackbar-surface.

tokens.name: snackbar-action
tokens.usage: Snackbar action label on snackbar-surface (inverse primary: blue-300 on the dark snackbar, blue-800 on the light one). 7.0:1 light, 5.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and modal sheets (black 32%).

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Tailwind black. Palette reference; for text and surfaces use the semantic tokens.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Tailwind white. Palette reference; for text and surfaces use the semantic tokens.

color.note: Semantic Classic Material Design roles first (primary through scrim), then the Tailwind CSS v4.1 palette: 22 hues × 11 steps plus black and white, the same in both themes. Contrast figures for palette steps are measured on their sRGB-clamped values.

families.sans: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Type scale
groups.note: The Classic Material Design type scale: thirteen styles at Light, Regular and Medium weights, set in the platform's system UI font (system-ui), falling back to Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue and Arial. Material Symbols Outlined loads as a web font.

styles.name: headline1
styles.usage: Light 96. Hero numbers and display moments only; rarely more than one per screen.

styles.name: headline4
styles.usage: Regular 34. Page titles on large screens.

styles.name: headline5
styles.usage: Regular 24. Section titles, card titles in feature cards.

styles.name: headline6
styles.usage: Medium 20. App bar titles, dialog titles, card titles.

styles.name: subtitle1
styles.usage: Regular 16. List primary lines, field input text.

styles.name: body1
styles.sample: Body 1 sets long-form reading text at a comfortable 16px.
styles.usage: Regular 16. Default body copy, dialog body.

styles.name: body2
styles.sample: Body 2 sets dense UI text, list secondary lines and snackbars.
styles.usage: Regular 14. Dense body, snackbar message, chip and checkbox labels.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Medium 14, ALL CAPS. Button and tab labels; apply text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Regular 12. Helper text, captions, inactive bottom-navigation labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Regular 10, ALL CAPS. Labels above headlines; apply text-transform: uppercase.

spacing.note: An 8dp grid; 4dp steps for icons and small type alignment.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; half-step alignment.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Base grid unit: gaps between buttons, dialog action padding, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding; filled text field label inset.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding, list item insets, mobile screen margins, contained and outlined button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, tablet margins, gutters between cards.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section spacing within a screen.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; space between major blocks.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Large section breaks; desktop page margins.

radius.note: Classic Material Design radii: small and medium components 4dp, large components square. Every rounded rectangle draws its radius with squircle corners (squircle-scale and squircle-shape, where corner-shape is supported); pills and circles stay round.

tokens.name: shape-none
tokens.usage: Large components: navigation drawer, bottom sheets, app bars, bottom navigation.

tokens.name: shape-small
tokens.usage: Small components: buttons, text fields, snackbars. Drawn with squircle corners (5px rendered where corner-shape is supported).

tokens.name: shape-medium
tokens.usage: Medium components: cards, dialogs, menus. Drawn with squircle corners (5px rendered where corner-shape is supported).

tokens.name: shape-chip
tokens.usage: Chips: a full pill at 32px height. Stays a plain round pill; no squircle corners.

tokens.name: shape-full
tokens.usage: FAB, switch thumb, radio, avatars: circles. Stay round; no squircle corners.

tokens.name: shape-squircle
tokens.usage: Quantum's squircle corner radius: the default for .rounded-squircle. A length, so it holds on boxes of any proportion; the element's short side must be at least 60px (24px × 1.24418 ≤ half the short side).

shadow.note: Classic Material Design elevation: three-layer umbra / penumbra / ambient shadows. In dark theme also lighten the surface with the matching surface-dpNN token.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Elevation 0: flat surfaces, outlined cards, text and outlined buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: cards at rest, chips (pressed).

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Elevation 2: contained button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-4
tokens.usage: Elevation 4: top app bar; contained button hovered.

tokens.name: shadow-6
tokens.usage: Elevation 6: FAB at rest, snackbar.

tokens.name: shadow-8
tokens.usage: Elevation 8: bottom navigation, menus, raised card, contained button pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-12
tokens.usage: Elevation 12: FAB pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-16
tokens.usage: Elevation 16: navigation drawer, modal bottom sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-24
tokens.usage: Elevation 24: dialogs.

opacity.note: State-layer and emphasis opacities, applied over on-surface (or on-primary on primary fills).

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover overlay on surface (0.08 on primary fills).

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus overlay (0.24 on primary fills).

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: Selected list item, chip or nav item overlay.

tokens.name: state-activated
tokens.usage: Activated (current) navigation item overlay.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed ripple opacity (0.24 on primary fills).

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged component overlay.

corner.note: Constants that turn a radius into a continuous-curvature corner with CSS corner-shape, from arfct/squircle. Both are scale-invariant.

tokens.name: squircle-scale
tokens.usage: Multiplier on the authored radius where corner-shape is supported; best fit to a three-Bézier continuous corner (fits fall between 1.2440 and 1.2560 for ratios 0.10–0.40).

tokens.name: squircle-shape
tokens.usage: corner-shape value: |x|^s + |y|^s = 1 with s = 2^1.39 = 2.62. Residual 0.33% of the authored radius (0.88px on a 1024px icon at 26%).
